errors.text: The proposed Mg-Cr-Fe-Ni-Al composition replaces the target MgAlTiVFeCo system without direct evidence that Mg is soluble or entropy-stabilized in this transition-metal matrix.
The hypothesis selects 900 °C as optimal, whereas the target optimum is SPS at 1000 °C, where the highest density, hardness, oxidation resistance, and corrosion resistance occur.

The falsification experiment varies composition primarily at one temperature rather than comparing intermediate temperatures with 1000 °C, so it cannot discriminate the requested temperature-optimum hypothesis.
The proposed Al2O3/Cr2O3 barrier mechanism does not reconstruct the target uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases or the associated biphasic parabolic oxidation behavior.
The cited evidence is predominantly from Mg-free Co-Cr-Fe-Ni-Al alloys and therefore does not validate suppression of Mg segregation or volatility.
